title: Capture
intro: A group with no liberties is captured and removed from the board. A group with one liberty left is in atari.

steps.instruction: White has one liberty left. Play there to capture the stone.
steps.hint: Put your cursor on the white stone and look at where the ring is.
steps.explanation: The white stone comes off. It goes into your prisoner pile for counting at the end.

steps.instruction: Find the last liberty of this white group. Capture it.
steps.hint: A chain shares its liberties. Find the single empty point they are all relying on.
steps.explanation: All three stones come off together. A connected group shares its liberties.
Both stones come off when you fill their last liberty.

outro: Next, we will try a move that is not allowed.
